evidence:
Walked the brief and the six notes line by line against solution/app source. Every asked-for capability has an implementation; none is missing.

Workspace (overview.md, instruction.md): editor, preview and console rendered together in one page at / (app.tsx:321-341); title and filename fields, Save (app.tsx:323); Run and Stop (app.tsx:319); New (app.tsx:328, example draft app.tsx:267-271); shared library list (app.tsx:329) and read-only history with Restore (app.tsx:330-333); no sign-in.

Editor (ui.md): own DOM text model on a non-editable div, no textarea/input/contenteditable surface and no ready-made editor in package.json (custom-editor.js:23, grep of src finds none); numbered lines and Ln/Col readout (1109, 1125-1127); typing, Enter, Backspace, Delete, arrows, Home, End, Shift-extend (323-355, 775-812); remembered column on vertical moves (795-800); grapheme-aware move/delete for emoji and combining accents (884-922); caret kept in view horizontally and vertically (1145-1160) with unwrapped scrollable lines (style.css:14,16,18); click, double-click word, triple-click line, drag with auto-scroll (358-447); copy/cut/paste via clipboard events, paste as one undo step (248-267, 570-586); Tab/Shift+Tab indent/outdent of every touched line as one undo, skipping a next line touched only at column 0 (843-866); Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click multi-caret, same-line carets tracked by document offset, burst grouped into one undo (364-379, 592-610, 574-580, 680-724); Undo/Redo buttons and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y restoring caret from the snapshot, disabled when empty (190-242, 298-308, 1165-1166); literal case-sensitive Find, wrapping next/previous, Replace current that skips inserted text, Replace all as one undo (978-1102); token colouring for JS keywords, function names at declaration and call, strings, numbers, comments and HTML tags, attribute names, quoted values, comments with seven distinct colours (105-188, style.css:25-31); Prettier Format for JS and HTML, two-space, one undo, error message leaving the draft untouched (83-104); Escape-then-Tab exit shown on screen (271-277, 1174, app.tsx:343); worded feedback after Run, Save and Format (app.tsx:320,242; custom-editor.js:99); focus returned to the code after Format, Undo, Redo, replace and Save (65, 68, 92, 98, app.tsx:246); dirty marker computed against the saved baseline so it clears on Save and on Undo back to saved text (app.tsx:214, 315, 322); 390 px layout rules with no sideways page scroll (style.css:34-50, 73).

Running (behaviour.md): fresh sandboxed iframe per run, .html replaces the document (runtime.ts:314-365, 382-393); syntax error reported with line, draft untouched (386); ordered console (158, app.tsx:216) never cleared by a run; thrown errors, errors in HTML scripts/handlers and unhandled rejections reported with one-based line and message text (113, 213-229, 357); last-good snapshot incl. control values and canvas pixels restored on throw, Stop or timeout (159-203, 8-31, 375-381, 403); 4.9 s in-frame guard plus 5.1 s parent watchdog covering timers and Promise callbacks, fresh budget on trusted interaction (139-141, 231-282, 374, 400); Stop and a newer Run discard the old frame and token so stale callbacks cannot write (378-395).

Saving (behaviour.md, integration.md): SQLite via DB_PATH or /app/app.db resolved from __dirname, 0.0.0.0:3000, /api/health (server.js:8, 12, 142-170); exact title/filename/code stored (41-51, 67-90); revision check gives 409 without changing the record and the client keeps the draft and shows a conflict notice (52-59, app.tsx:243-246, 324); 2 s list-only polling that never touches the editor, title or filename, with a newer-revision notice (app.tsx:307-314, 325); restore creates a new revision, refuses a stale base and is idempotent by operation id (server.js:95-119).

Security (security.md): opaque-origin sandbox on a different hostname, CSP connect-src 'none' and no unsafe-eval, so fetch, eval, Function, WebAssembly and workers are refused with one clear message; dynamic import refused from the AST only, so the words in strings and comments stay harmless (runtime.ts:7, 50-52, 79-87, 220-228, 376, 387-391; server.js:16).

The shipped bundle contains the reviewed source (12 distinctive strings from src all found in public/assets/index.js; editor and token rules found in index.css). Raw evidence index: all 16 scripted-golden artifact hashes recomputed and match; editor.json, runtime.json, persist-before/after.json and polish.json hold 51 true and 0 false results on these exact bytes. Limits kept in view: that is a scripted run in the agent image with paste-event fixtures, not a configured judge run; the 0.9833 hosted Oracle score belongs to an earlier candidate and is not a measurement of these bytes. This row asks for plausible coverage, which the source walk establishes; whether each criterion passes under the judge is row 18's question.

Non-blocking observations: double-click treats '-' as a word character (custom-editor.js:468); a leftover 'section-heading' class with no CSS rule (1119-1122); the span with id save-state shows the search match count, the real dirty marker is in the pane heading (1163-1164).
